claims.statement: NamEngine (t3k::nam) hosts the in-tree NeuralAmpModelerCore nam::DSP engine (plugin/NeuralAmpModelerCore, compiled with the TONED_PLUGIN define; NAM_SAMPLE = double — the engine runs float64) as a JUCE::AudioProcessor — it is a NAM model, not an effect. prepare/apply is split: prepare() builds the engine on the message thread (NAM engine construction is NOT audio-thread safe), apply() sets parameters; the swap is done with a wet fade-in and a 125 dB floor so there is no audible pop on model swap (see ChainBlock.h::kWetFadeSeconds on the chain-side fade law).

NAM model loading is gated by the engine's own A2/A3 tier check (namConfigIsA2 / namConfigIsA3 via nam::DSP::create — the A3 path is the slower A2-fast container; A2 is the fast path). Slimmable models expose a setSlimmableSize(0.0..1.0) — TONE3000 fans this through to every NamPhase (each phase's DSP owns its own slim state), so a single knob controls every phase in the phase-interleave group. The engine does NOT accept float32; NAM_SAMPLE is double and the TONE3000 side does float↔double conversion at the processor/chain boundary (processor float32, engine float64) — a bit-exactness contract.
